Navigation.description: Configures the navigation and pager shapes. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:Navigation'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Navigation/.

PagerOptions.description: Configures the pagers. Note that the Settings module, which is always enabled, overrides these values with the paging values of the site general settings.

PageSize.description: The default number of items per page.

MaxPageSize.description: The maximum number of items per page. A value of 0 means no maximum.

MaxPagedCount.description: When greater than 0, the total number of items assumed by the content items admin pager instead of counting the items, which avoids an expensive count query on large databases. A value of 0 counts the items.

AllowPageSizeSelection.description: Whether users are allowed to change the number of items displayed per page by selecting one of the 'PageSizeOptions' values.

PageSizeOptions.description: The page sizes a user can select from when 'AllowPageSizeSelection' is enabled.

OrchardCore_Navigation.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Navigation' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Navigation' instead.
